responsibility: This header implements GCC’s generic splay-tree utility templates. It defines accessor adapters for nodes with or without parent links, common base operations, rooted and rootless splay-tree classes, default node wrappers, insertion/lookup/splay/navigation/splitting/removal primitives, and debug-print support, providing reusable tree algorithms for compiler structures that want splay-tree behavior without depending directly on libiberty’s C API.
same_name_distinction: Defines the reusable modern splay-tree utility templates, accessors, and rooted/rootless tree classes; the same-stem .cc file is only CHECKING_P test coverage for those templates, not part of the runtime implementation.
